class.name: NotificationListener
class.lead: Interface to receive notification from other oneM2M entities.
class.description:
Interface to receive notification from other oneM2M entities.
Application that receives notification must implement this interface and register to OSGi service registry. No service property is required.

class.name: OneM2MException
class.description: General Exception for oneM2M.

method.name: OneM2MException
method.lead: Construct a OneM2MException with a message and an error code.
method.description: Construct a OneM2MException with a message and an error code.

method.name: getErrorCode
method.lead: Return the error code for the exception.
method.description: Return the error code for the exception.
method.return: The error code for the exception.

class.name: ServiceLayer
class.lead: Primary Interface for an oneM2M application entity to send request and get response to/from other oneM2M entity.
class.description:
Primary Interface for an oneM2M application entity to send request and get response to/from other oneM2M entity.
It contains low level API and high level API. The only low level method is request() and other methods are categorized as high level API.

method.name: request
method.lead: send a request and receive response.
method.description:
send a request and receive response.
This method allows very raw data type access and it enables all possible message exchanges among oneM2M entities. This is called the low level API. This method allows all possible operation of oneM2M. For the return type, OSGi Promise is used for allowing synchronous and asynchronous calling manner.

method.name: create
method.description:
create resource
The create() method is a method to create new resource under specified uri. The second argument resource is expression of resource to be generated. The resourceType field of the resourceDTO must be assigned. For other fields depends on resource type. Section 7.4 of TS-00004 specifies the optionalities of the fields.
method.param: URI for parent resource of the resource being created.

method.name: retrieve
method.description:
retrieve resource
retrieve resource on URI specified by uri argument. This method retrieve all attributes of the resource.

method.name: retrieve
method.description:
retrieve resource with selected attributes.
retrieve resource on URI specified by uri argument. This method retrieve selected attributes by targetAttributes argument. The retrieve() methods are methods to retrieve resource on URI specified by uri argument.

method.name: update
method.description:
update resource
The update() method is a method to update resource on the URI specified by uri argument. The resource argument holds attributes to be updated. Attributes not to be updated shall not included in the argument.

method.name: delete
method.description:
delete resource
delete resource on the URI specified by uri argument.

method.name: discovery
method.lead: find resources with filter condition specified in fc argument.
method.description:
find resources with filter condition specified in fc argument.
Discovery Result Type is kept as blank and default value of target CSE is used for the parameter.
method.param: URI for resource tree to start the search
method.return: list of URIs matching the condition specified in fc

method.name: discovery
method.lead: find resources with filter condition specified in fc argument.
method.description:
find resources with filter condition specified in fc argument.
With this method application can specify desired identifier in result
method.param: URI for resource tree to start the search
method.return: list of URIs matching the condition specified in fc

package.name: org.osgi.service.onem2m.dto

class.name: AttributeDTO
class.description:
DTO expresses Attribute.
This class is typically used in FilterCriteriaDTO for expressing matching condition.

class.name: ChildResourceRefDTO
class.description: DTO expresses ChildResourceRef.

field.name: name
field.lead: name of the child resource pointed to by the URI
field.description: name of the child resource pointed to by the URI

field.name: type
field.lead: resourceType of the child resource pointed to by the URI
field.description: resourceType of the child resource pointed to by the URI

field.name: specializationID
field.lead: resource type specialization of the child resource pointed to by the URI in case type represents a flexContainer.
field.description: resource type specialization of the child resource pointed to by the URI in case type represents a flexContainer. This is an optional field.

class.name: Constants
class.lead: This class defines constants for resource types.
class.description: This class defines constants for resource types.

class.name: DasInfoDTO
class.description: DTO expresses DasInfo. DAS is short for Dynamic Authorization Server.

field.name: dasRequest
field.lead: Information to send to the Dynamic Authorization Server
field.description: Information to send to the Dynamic Authorization Server

field.name: securedDasRequest
field.lead: Secured Information to send to the Dynamic Authorization Server.
field.description: Secured Information to send to the Dynamic Authorization Server. JWS or JWE is assigned to this field.

class.name: FilterCriteriaDTO
class.description: DTO expresses FilterCriteria. This data structure is used for searching resources.

class.name: GenericDTO
class.lead: GenericDTO expresses miscellaneous data structures of oneM2M.
class.description: GenericDTO expresses miscellaneous data structures of oneM2M.

field.name: element
field.description: Substructure of DTO. Type of the value part should be one of types allowed as OSGi DTO.

class.name: IPEDiscoveryRequestDTO
class.lead: IPEDiscoveryRequestDTO is an element of NotificationEventDTO
class.description: IPEDiscoveryRequestDTO is an element of NotificationEventDTO

class.name: LocalTokenIdAssignmentDTO
class.description: DTO expresses LocalTokenIdAssignment.

class.name: NotificationDTO
class.description: DTO expresses Notification.

field.name: verificationRequest
field.description: Flag showing verification request. This field is optional.

field.name: subscriptionDeletion
field.lead: Flag showing subscription deletion This field is optional.
field.description: Flag showing subscription deletion This field is optional.

class.name: NotificationEventDTO
class.description:
DTO expresses NotificationEventDTO
This data structure is held in NotificationDTO.

class.name: PrimitiveContentDTO
class.description:
DTO expresses Primitive Content.
This Data structure is used as union. Only one field MUST have a value, the others MUST be null.

class.name: ReleaseVersion
class.description:
enum expresses oneM2M specification version.
This information is introduced after Release 2.0 and oneM2M uses only R2A, R3_0 (as 2a and 3).

class.name: RequestPrimitiveDTO
class.description: DTO expresses Request Primitive.

field.name: from
field.description:
From Parameter.
Originator of the request is stored.

field.name: requestExpirationTimestamp
field.description:
Request Expiration Timestamp
* This parameter is related to CMDH(Communication Management and Delivery Handling) policy.

field.name: resultExpirationTimestamp
field.description:
Result Expiration Timestamp
This parameter is related to CMDH(Communication Management and Delivery Handling) policy.

field.name: resultPersistence
field.description:
Result Persistence
This parameter is related to CMDH(Communication Management and Delivery Handling) policy.

field.name: eventCategory
field.description:
Event Category
allowed values are 2(Immediate), 3(BestEffort), 4(Latest), and 100-999 as user defined range.

field.name: deliveryAggregation
field.description:
Delivery Aggregation
This parameter is related to CMDH(Communication Management and Delivery Handling) policy.

field.name: groupRequestIdentifier
field.lead: Group Request Identifier TODO: search doc.
field.description: Group Request Identifier TODO: search doc.

field.name: desiredIdentifierResultType
field.description:
Desired Identifier Result Type
This parameter specifies identifier type in response, such as structured or unstructured. This parameter used to be Discovery Result Type in previous oneM2M release.

field.name: tokens
field.description:
Tokens
Each token is in m2m:dynAuthJWT

field.name: tokenIDs
field.description:
Token Identifiers
In oneM2M this parameter is expressed as list of m2m:tokenID.

field.name: localTokenIDs
field.description:
Local Token Identifiers
In oneM2M this parameter is expressed as list of xs:NCName.

field.name: authorizationSignatures
field.description:
Authorization Signatures
In oneM2M this parameter is expressed in m2m:signatureList.

field.name: vendorInformation
field.description:
Vendor Information
Used for vendor specific information. No procedure is defined for the parameter.

class.name: ResourceDTO
class.description:
DTO expresses Resource.
Universal attributes are expressed in field of the class. Common attributes and other attributes are stored in attribute field.

field.name: parentID
field.lead: Parent ID Resource ID of parent resource.
field.description: Parent ID Resource ID of parent resource.

field.name: attribute
field.description: Non Universal Attribute. Value Part must be the types that are allowed for OSGi DTO. In case of value part can be expressed DTO in this package, the DTO must be used. In case of value part have sub-elements, GenericDTO must be used.

class.name: ResourceWrapperDTO
class.description: DTO expresses ResourceWrapper.

class.description: DTO expresses Response Primitive.

field.name: eventCategory
field.description:
Event Category
allowed values are 2(Immediate), 3(BestEffort), 4(Latest), and 100-999 as user defined range.

field.name: vendorInformation
field.description:
Vendor Information
Used for vendor specific information. No procedure is defined for the parameter.

class.name: ResponseTypeInfoDTO
class.description: DTO expresses ResponseTypeInfo

class.name: SecurityInfoDTO
class.description:
DTO expresses Security Info.
This class is used as union. SecurityInfoType field indicates which type of content is stored.
